# Third-Party Provenance and Attribution

`DemaConsulting.CanvasNet.MathMl` renders MathML Core. Its code is original, but five of its data tables are
**derived with attribution** from W3C and Unicode data files, listed below. The license texts of those sources ship
with the package (in its `licenses\` folder), and every generated data file starts with the header comments
`// Generated by tools/mathml-data/update-mathml-tables.ps1 from <source>; do not edit by hand.` and
`// Portions derived from ... (W3C|Unicode); see third-party/README.md`. The tables are local source code, generated
once by a developer tool and committed; no upstream package is a dependency and nothing is downloaded at build or run
time.

This project is **not affiliated with, and is not endorsed or promoted by**, the World Wide Web Consortium (W3C) or
Unicode, Inc. The names are used only to describe the language that is implemented and the data that is used.

## What Is Not Taken

No source text, prose, example, or test of the W3C specifications or of the Unicode Standard is copied. The layout
algorithms of MathML Core are implemented from the specification text in original C#; the specification is cited in
the design documentation. The bundled Noto Sans Math font and its SIL Open Font License notice belong to the core
`DemaConsulting.CanvasNet` package, not to this one.
